items.docs: Authenticates with `email`/`password` and returns a JWT `idToken` to use as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header for every other request. The token expires 60 minutes after issuance; call this endpoint again with the same credentials to obtain a new one — there is no separate refresh endpoint. If `email` or `password` is missing or malformed, the validation error response never echoes back the submitted values.
